title: Installation media qualification record, version 1
description: The machine-consumed result of qualifying installation media. Produced host-side before a build and consumed by the Packer builder, which reverifies the media against it at its own input boundary. Scope: this record fingerprints the artifact and carries forward the declared installation selection. It does not establish that the media actually contains the edition, index, architecture, or language declared -- nothing here opens the ISO. The pre-seal checks compare the installed operating system against this declared intent.

runId.description: The run that produced this record, correlating it with the rest of the build's evidence.

outcome.description: Only a passed record may be consumed by a build. A failed record exists so a refusal is recorded rather than inferred from an absent file.

reasonCode.description: Present when and only when the outcome is failed.

reference.description: The exact media reference this record qualified, carried forward so the builder does not have to re-read the declaration to know what it is verifying.

integrity.description: The algorithm, the expected digest, and the digest actually observed, recorded separately so a reader can see the comparison rather than take its result on trust. Digest lengths are checked against the algorithm before this record may be written.

observedDigest.description: Null when the artifact could not be read at all. Never absent, so a record cannot imply a comparison that did not happen.

authority.description: Where the expected digest was obtained. Independence from the artifact is NOT proven by this contract: it is constrained structurally -- the citation must be an HTTPS reference, which a path beside the media cannot be -- and otherwise attested by the reviewer who approved the reference. Do not read a valid citation as a verified one.

image.description: The declared installation selection, carried forward. Intent, not an observation of the media's contents.

platform.description: The declared architecture and language, carried forward. Intent, not an observation of the media's contents.
